title: Oven Roasted Brazilian Egg Frittata
description: A peppery and shattering Brazilian dish featuring free-range eggs, perfect for a hangover cure, with pescatarian-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced smoked salmon, chopped onion, and chopped bell pepper to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the rendered lardons in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
